patch_list: Disables Firebase Analytics, Singular, Facebook App Events, Crashlytics and the app's own usage events.
Hides the selected sections from the home screen.
Removes ads and the advertising consent prompt.
Unlocks premium stickers and effects. Removes ads, subscription screens, the daily save limit and the video watermark. AI tools need account credits.
